hero.title: About MultiMart
hero.text: MultiMart is a next-generation classifieds platform where thousands of sellers and buyers find each other every day. We're building a convenient, fast, and safe space to trade goods and services across Ukraine.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: We believe buying and selling should be simple. MultiMart connects people, helps items find new owners, and helps businesses find new customers. Every listing is an opportunity, and our job is to make that opportunity accessible to everyone.

safety.title: Deal safety
safety.text: Verified sellers, safe payment and delivery methods — we care about the peace of mind of every deal.

speed.title: Speed
speed.text: Post a listing or find the item you need in just a few minutes.

community.title: Community
community.text: Thousands of buyers and sellers across Ukraine find each other on MultiMart every day.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.text: The service operates in every region of Ukraine with local delivery through trusted partners.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.text: Post your first listing or browse thousands of offers today.

deliveryRules.title: Delivery rules
deliveryRules.subtitle: Delivery and payment methods, timeframes, packaging requirements, and Nova Poshta's policy — everything you need to know before checkout.

novaPoshta.title: OLX Delivery (Nova Poshta)
novaPoshta.text: The seller ships the parcel to the branch or parcel locker you choose. You can track the status by the tracking number in the order chat.

selfPickup.title: Self pickup
selfPickup.text: You pick up the item directly from the seller. The address and time are agreed in the chat after checkout.

courier.title: Courier delivery
courier.text: A courier delivers the order to the specified address. Availability depends on the seller's and buyer's location.

cardOnline.title: Pay online by card
cardOnline.text: Funds are charged immediately at checkout and held until the item's receipt is confirmed.

cashOnDelivery.title: Cash on delivery
cashOnDelivery.text: Payment on pickup at a Nova Poshta branch. The cash-on-delivery fee is paid by the recipient per the carrier's rates.

deliveryRules.timeframesNote: Timeframes are estimates and may vary depending on Nova Poshta branch workload and the actual handover date to the carrier.

packagingRules.0: The item must be packaged according to its weight, size, and fragility — a box or packaging that can withstand transport.
packagingRules.1: Fragile and electronic items must be additionally wrapped in cushioning material (bubble wrap, foam).
packagingRules.2: The parcel must have the correct tracking number and the recipient's contact details.
packagingRules.3: Liquids, pressurized substances, and carrier-restricted items must be packaged per Nova Poshta's rules.

prohibitedItems.4: Items prohibited for shipping under Ukrainian law

deliveryRules.prohibitedNote: The full list of restrictions is determined by Nova Poshta JSC's current carriage rules.
deliveryRules.footerPrefix: Preparing a parcel for shipping? Check out

deliverySafety.title: Delivery safety
deliverySafety.subtitle: How to safely receive a Nova Poshta parcel and recognize delivery-related fraud.

0.title: Verify the tracking number
0.text: Compare the tracking number on the parcel with the one in the order chat / Nova Poshta SMS — they must match exactly.

1.title: Inspect the packaging before accepting
1.text: Check the box/packaging integrity at the branch: tears, dents, signs of opening or repackaging are grounds for a damage report.

2.title: Open it in front of the branch staff
2.text: You have the right to open the parcel at the branch before signing any documents, to check the contents match the order.

3.title: File a report if damaged
3.text: If the contents are damaged or don't match the description — don't sign for receipt without a damage report filed by branch staff.

4.title: Keep confirmations
4.text: Unboxing photos/video and the cash-on-delivery payment receipt will be useful if you need to contact support.

checkEn.title: Verify the tracking number
checkEn.text: The waybill number must match the one in the order chat.

filmUnboxing.title: Film the unboxing
filmUnboxing.text: Video will serve as evidence in case of a content dispute.

dontShareCodes.title: Don't share codes
dontShareCodes.text: The SMS code is meant only for you.

tips.0: Never share the SMS confirmation code from Nova Poshta or MultiMart with anyone — it's your personal parcel access code.
tips.1: Official parcel status notifications come only directly from Nova Poshta — don't click links in suspicious SMS about "customs fees."
tips.2: Don't pay extra "customs clearance" or "insurance" fees through third-party sites — all shipping fees are paid only at the branch or in the carrier's app.
tips.3: Only the person named on the waybill, or a trusted person with ID and a power of attorney, may receive the parcel.
tips.4: Make sure the recipient's phone number and full name on the order are your own, not someone you don't trust.

redFlags.0: A call/SMS asking you to "confirm" a transfer or state the SMS code to "receive" a parcel
redFlags.1: A demand to pay extra for delivery to a private card instead of via an official receipt
redFlags.2: A tracking number that can't be found in the official Nova Poshta app/website
redFlags.3: The sender insists you take the parcel without inspecting the contents

contact.title: Parcel damaged or lost?
contact.text: Contact a Nova Poshta branch to file a report, and notify the seller in the order chat — MultiMart will help resolve the dispute.

info.label: Information
info.heading: Information about MultiMart
info.intro: Who we are, the terms the platform operates under, and how to reach us.

aboutUs.title: About us
aboutUs.text: MultiMart is a classifieds platform where thousands of sellers and buyers find each other every day. We're building a convenient and safe space to trade goods and services across Ukraine.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.text: By registering on MultiMart, users agree to post only accurate product information, follow chat communication rules, and not violate Ukrainian law. The full terms are available on request from support.

careers.title: Careers
careers.text: The MultiMart team is growing — current open positions are posted in the careers section. Resumes can be sent via the support chat's feedback form.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.text: Support line: 0 800 123 456 (toll-free within Ukraine), support chat is available from any page of the site after logging in.

help.label: Help
help.heading: Help Center
help.intro: Answers about credit, warranty, returns, and service centers. Delivery and deal safety questions are on separate pages below.

credit.title: Credit
credit.text: You can finance a purchase through partner banks right on the checkout page — choose "Credit" as the payment method and enter the required details.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.text: The warranty period is set by the seller on the product page. For warranty service, contact the seller via chat or the nearest service center with proof of purchase.

returns.title: Returns
returns.text: An item of proper quality can be returned within 14 days of receipt if it hasn't been used and retains its original condition. Arrange a return via chat with the seller.

serviceCenters.title: Service centers
serviceCenters.text: The list of authorized service centers by product category is provided by the seller on the listing page or by support on request.

services.label: Services
services.heading: MultiMart Services
services.intro: Additional features for buyers and businesses.

bonusAccount.title: Bonus account
bonusAccount.text: Earn bonuses for purchases and use them to pay for part of future orders. Your balance is shown in your personal account.

card.title: MultiMart Card
card.text: The partner card gives extended cashback on purchases and access to discounts from the service's partners.

giftCards.title: Gift cards
giftCards.text: Electronic gift cards of your chosen denomination can be gifted or used as payment for a MultiMart order.

pharmacyExchange.title: Pharmacy Exchange
pharmacyExchange.text: An exchange service for the pharmacy category — arranged directly with the seller in the order chat.

corporate.title: For corporate clients
corporate.text: Wholesale terms, VAT invoices, and a personal manager are available for legal entities. Contact support chat with the topic "For corporate clients."

partners.label: For partners
partners.heading: MultiMart for Partners
partners.intro: Opportunities for sellers, advertisers, and business partners.

sell.title: Sell on MultiMart
sell.text: Create your first listing in a few minutes — the "Add listing" button is available in the top menu after logging in.

ads.title: Advertising
ads.text: Advertising opportunities on the platform — banners, listing and category promotion. Details and pricing are provided by the support team.

cooperation.title: Cooperation
cooperation.text: Open to partnerships with brands, delivery services, and other providers. Send proposals via support chat.

franchise.title: Franchising
franchise.text: Terms of MultiMart's franchise model for regional partners are provided upon individual request.

rental.title: Rental
rental.text: The rental section for goods and real estate operates under the same listing rules as sales.

helpCenter.footerPrefix: Delivery and deal safety questions are on separate pages:

security.title: Safety on MultiMart
security.subtitle: Tips to help you buy and sell safely — recognize fraud, protect your personal data, and negotiate confidently with other users.
security.buyerRulesHeading: Basic rules for a safe deal

meetInPublic.title: Meet in public places
meetInPublic.text: Choose busy, well-lit locations for in-person meetings — shopping centers, post offices, busy streets. Avoid meeting alone in stairwells or deserted places.

payAfterCheck.title: Pay after checking the item
payAfterCheck.text: Inspect the item in person before paying. If paying online, use only "OLX Delivery" with payment-on-receipt verification, not direct transfers to strangers.

dontShareData.title: Don't share unnecessary data
dontShareData.text: A seller never needs your card details, CVV code, SMS confirmation codes, or banking app password to complete a deal. If asked — it's a scam.

checkSeller.title: Check the seller
checkSeller.text: Look at the rating and number of reviews, account registration date, and whether the phone number is verified. A new account with no history is a reason to be more careful.

0.title: Communicate in MultiMart chat
0.text: The entire conversation and history of agreements are saved — this protects you in case of a dispute.

1.title: Check the listing and profile
1.text: Rating, reviews, registration date — these warn of potentially risky deals.

2.title: Inspect the item before paying
2.text: Whenever possible, in person or via a delivery branch with content-inspection option.

3.title: Use safe payment methods
3.text: "OLX Delivery" with cash on delivery, or card payment through the official app — never off-platform.

4.title: Report anything suspicious
4.text: Report a listing or user — the MultiMart support team will review the report.

redFlags.0: A price far below market value "to sell quickly"
redFlags.1: The seller insists on prepayment to a card before you can inspect the item
redFlags.2: A request to call/message "in another messenger" right away, bypassing MultiMart chat
redFlags.3: Links to "verify" or "unfreeze an account" outside the official website
redFlags.4: A request for your SMS code or card CVV
redFlags.5: Listings with no product photos, or with photos "stolen" from the internet

personalData.paragraph1: Don't post passport details, your full home address, or card details in listings. For delivery, the settlement and branch are enough — the exact address is shared only with the delivery service, not directly with another user.
personalData.paragraph2: MultiMart never asks for your password, SMS code, or full card number by email, phone, or chat. Any such request is phishing, even if the sender claims to be "support."

security.reportText: Report the listing or user, or contact support — we'll review the report and take action.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: Rules for using the MultiMart platform for buyers and sellers.

general.title: 1. General provisions
general.text: By using MultiMart, the user agrees to these terms of use. If you disagree with any provision, please refrain from using the service. We may update these terms; the current version is always available on this page.

account.title: 2. Registration and account
account.text: Posting listings requires registration with a valid email address and phone number. The user is responsible for keeping their account credentials confidential and for all actions taken under their account.

content.title: 3. Posting listings
content.text: Listings must contain accurate information about the item or service, correct photos, and a real price. Posting listings for items prohibited under Ukrainian law, as well as misleading or offensive content, is forbidden.

communication.title: 4. Communication and deals
communication.text: Communication between buyer and seller takes place through the platform's chat. MultiMart is not a party to the deal between users and does not guarantee product quality — we recommend inspecting the item in person before payment.

payments.title: 5. Payment and delivery
payments.text: Payment and delivery are arranged directly between the buyer and seller. For safe transactions, we recommend using verified delivery services with cash on delivery.

liability.title: 6. Liability of the parties
liability.text: MultiMart makes efforts to maintain a safe environment but is not liable for users' actions, product quality, or fulfillment of obligations under deals between buyer and seller.

privacy.title: 7. Privacy
privacy.text: Users' personal data is processed in accordance with current Ukrainian personal data protection law and is used solely to operate the service.

termination.title: 8. Suspension of access
termination.text: MultiMart reserves the right to restrict or suspend account access in the event of a violation of these terms, including fraud, spam, or posting prohibited content.

terms.lastUpdated: Last updated: 08/10/2026. For questions about the terms of use, please contact support.
